verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's own docs describe stale-flag detection: it can automatically detect stale flags so teams can clean them up. That covers the 'find stale flags' half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows code-reference scanning, so the 'code references' half that drives actual removal from the codebase is unevidenced. Missing for 10: code references / codebase scanning to locate flag usages, detail on stale-detection criteria and workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can find stale flags and code references so temporary flags actually get removed from the codebase

citations.quote: GrowthBook can automatically detect these flags so you can clean them up.
